descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S27 Every real write path stamps a clock the purge can use: items made through the app, then the whole chart moved back 37 h

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it. (UAT OAT-04 Expected 1; TFA-94699 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician on the local stack with one Hospital patient per write path, each item created through the app's own path: pre-round Save Note extraction (a vital, a lab, a medication row), a panel Save (Vitals, Labs, Imaging, Medications), Save & Extract, a prior note pasted with the date 5 days ago, a prior-note pho …

When Read every item's clock field, then move each chart's stored clocks (or the local server clock) back by 37 h, all by the same amount, and purge; read the raw documents

Then On every chart every item is gone, and no item's clock field was null before the move

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): OAT-04 (B), 3.6 and TFA-94699 AC 1: an item that survives, or whose clock field is null (it can never clear), = Fail. The prior-note labs: TC-13 stores them 'with the note's date', so they should already be past 36 h at the paste; judged per Q5 until answered

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

Every write path stamps a clock, and its items are purged at 37 h, except the open tasks Save & Extract created ('start pantoprazole 40 mg daily', 'recheck creatinine tomorrow morning'), which are still in the task list 37 h later.

Evidence: allure c3390642-…-result.json; retention lane. 34 checks pass, 1 fails, known K2. Recorded: a prior-note import stamps labsUpdatedAt with the import time, not the note's date (K16/Q5). Side note (config, not judged): the default vision model gemini-3.6-flash returns 404 in us-central1 (same on dev), so this throwaway backend used location 'global'.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S27

Every real write path stamps a clock the purge can use: items made through the app, then the whole chart moved back 37 h

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: yes): Browser + API: one chart per write path, each item created through the app: real pre-round Save Note extraction (vital, lab, med), panel saves (Vitals, Labs, Imaging/Findings, Medications) in the UI, real Save & Extract, prior note pasted with a date 5 days ago (real extraction), prior-note photo (real vision call + extraction), Quick Dictation assign (no AI; done = the text is on chart 6; a failed tap is tapped once more and the backend error kept); read every clock (null = Fail), shift every clock on every chart back 37 h, purge, raw rows. Vision: the app default model gemini-3.6-flash 404s in us-central1 (it comes from DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL with an empty aiProvider row and overrides VERTEX_AI_CONFIG.model), so this throwaway backend's VERTEX_AI_CONFIG location is set to 'global' (env of a backend this runner started; credentials never printed). — All six paths run on the isolated stack; the photo path needs the Vertex location set to 'global' on that backend (the default us-central1 404s, as on dev).

Where it ran: local

Detail:

34 judged items passed, 1 failed (1 known, 0 policy conflict, 0 not in the matrix knownGaps), 1 recorded against open questions — failed: gone.Save & Extract.tasks (Save & Extract: open tasks it created (start pantoprazole 40 mg daily; recheck creatinine tomorrow morning) after 37 h: expected absent, got present; known K2) — record-only: priorNoteLabDate = labsUpdatedAt 2026-10-14T07:38:35.265Z (import time, not the note's date Oct 9) [Q5 / TC-13 'stored with the note's date' (K16)] — notes: vision setup: VERTEX_AI_CONFIG on this throwaway backend (5910, started by this runner) has location 'global' (copied from the QA stack with 'us-central1'); the model is the app default gemini-3.6-flash: with an empty aiProvider row resolveConfig returns DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL (convex/aiProvider.ts:52, 75) and vision() passes it as args.model, which overrides VERTEX_AI_CONFIG.model (convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts:166), so changing the env model does nothing. In us-central1 that default returns 404 (first run here; dev shows the same 404). | Prior note photo:  | Quick Dictation: assigned on the first tap | live AI: {"total":7,"failed":0,"byFn":{"parsing.parsePreRoundNotes":1,"parsing.extractTasks":2,"parsing.extractMedicationEvents":1,"parsing.extractPriorNote":2,"vision.scanPriorNote":1}} app actions (aiCallLog); {"total":10,"failed":0,"byFn":{"ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes":4,"ai/parsing:extractTasks":2,"ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents":1,"ai/parsing:extractPriorNote":2,"ai/vision:scanPriorNote":1}} model requests (backend log) — Quick Dictation: in the first run this leg failed because the app's quickDictation:assign hit the local backend's 1 s execution limit on an overloaded laptop ('Function execution timed out', convex-5910.run1.log:398, inside requireUserId); re-run here (leg waits for the text on chart 6, one re-tap allowed and logged): assigned on the first tap. Prior-note photo: the first run's 404 came from the app default vision model gemini-3.6-flash (DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL with an empty aiProvider row, convex/aiProvider.ts:52/75, which overrides VERTEX_AI_CONFIG.model, vertex.ts:166) in us-central1 — changing the env model has no effect; with VERTEX_AI_CONFIG location 'global' on this throwaway backend the same model read the photo. Dev parity: dev's photo path 404s the same way (separate config issue). model requests counted in the notes.

Product issue: Every write path (Save Note, panel saves, Save & Extract, prior-note paste, prior-note photo, Quick Dictation) stamped a clock, and its items were purged 37 h later. The exception is the two open tasks that Save & Extract created ('start pantoprazole 40 mg daily', 'recheck creatinine tomorrow morning'): they are still in the task list 37 h later. Breaks UAT 3.6 (open tasks deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed) / TFA-94699 AC 1. Known in the matrix: K2.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation that moves a chart's stamps back, called with the local stack's admin key) and the retention-db runner, which seeds through e2e/support/backend.ts and reads the raw rows with adminQuery; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls only the l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
